question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a brown present, Bob has a gold present, Claire has a white present, Dave has a orange present, Eve has a green present, Fred has a silver present, and Gertrude has a teal present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Fred and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Finally, Gertrude and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Eve has the
Options:
(A) brown present
(B) gold present
(C) white present
(D) orange present
(E) green present
(F) silver present
(G) teal present
solution:
Each row lists present colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: brown, gold, white, orange, green, silver, teal
1. Fred ↔ Bob: brown, silver, white, orange, green, gold, teal
2. Gertrude ↔ Bob: brown, teal, white, orange, green, gold, silver
3. Dave ↔ Claire: brown, teal, orange, white, green, gold, silver
4. Dave ↔ Alice: white, teal, orange, brown, green, gold, silver
5. Bob ↔ Claire: white, orange, teal, brown, green, gold, silver
6. Claire ↔ Bob: white, teal, orange, brown, green, gold, silver
7. Gertrude ↔ Bob: white, silver, orange, brown, green, gold, teal
Eve has the green present, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
